metadata.title: Secure-Integration Relying System SSPP Template
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan template for systems that consume trust signals from the Secure-Integration Platform without generating independent trust assertions.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all trust semantics, amplification constraints, and non-equivalence rules from the Secure-Integration Platform SSPP.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure-Integration Relying System defines the contractual rules under which applications, processors, control planes, and downstream consumers may interpret and act upon integration trust signals. It prevents signal overreach, trust persistence, and implicit authorization.

props.name: relying-role
props.remarks: Consumes bounded, normalized integration trust and risk signals.

props.name: trust-consumption-model
props.remarks: Integration trust signals must not be cached, inherited, or reused beyond the immediate decision context.

props.name: business-authorization
props.remarks: Integration trust signals must not be interpreted as business authorization or approval.

props.name: signal-authority
props.remarks: Only signals produced and normalized by the Secure-Integration Platform may be consumed.

props.name: amplification-sensitive-consumption
props.remarks: Event fan-out, replay, mediation, and retention signals must be evaluated prior to downstream action.

system-implementation.remarks: Secure-Integration Relying Systems evaluate integration trust exclusively through normalized signals provided by the Secure-Integration Platform. They must not generate independent trust assertions, override non-equivalence constraints, or infer authorization from integration state.

components.title: Integration Core Signals
components.remarks: Eligibility, identity, and trust boundary signals.

components.title: Message Authenticity and Integrity Signals
components.remarks: Cryptographic validity and bounded replay signals.

components.title: Delivery and Failure Signals
components.remarks: Asynchronous delivery, poison handling, and failure containment signals.

components.title: Amplification and Fan-Out Signals
components.remarks: Producer authorization, consumer scope, and blast-radius signals.

components.title: Temporal Risk Signals
components.remarks: Replay authorization and retention-based trust degradation signals.

components.title: Semantic Validity Signals
components.remarks: Schema conformance and contract compatibility signals.

components.title: Mediation Risk Signals
components.remarks: Central mediation and privilege concentration indicators.

components.title: Integration Lifecycle Signals
components.remarks: Active, deprecated, retired, and revoked integration states.

components.title: Normalized Trust Signals
components.remarks: Decision-grade integration trust and risk abstractions.

components.title: Aggregate Integration Trust Signals
components.remarks: Bounded, revocable trust assertions computed from multiple contributing signals.

roles.title: Integration Trust Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines how integration trust signals may be consumed and ensures alignment with Secure-Integration architecture.

roles.title: Integration Trust Governance
roles.remarks: Approves reliance rules, amplification thresholds, and trust interpretation policies.

roles.title: Integration Consumer Operations
roles.remarks: Operates applications, processors, and services that consume integration trust signals.

roles.title: Integration Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors trust degradation, amplification effects, replay activity, and lifecycle events for escalation.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through correct consumption and interpretation of Secure-Integration trust signals. This SSPP does not implement enforcement or business logic.
